condition: recombinant WT shell expressed in E. coli; pH 3 disassembly followed by neutral-pH reassembly; stable incomplete assembly intermediate
notes: Stable incomplete WT shell assembly intermediate containing 52 Enc monomers. Retains an overall icosahedral-like geometry with a single opening. Relative to the 48-mer, two additional Enc dimers are incorporated around a threefold region.
